device.basis: Reset and gate controls of X-T20 2.11 section 5. SD start-up 0xc65b18 drives +0x1c bit 18, 19 or 20 low and then high for SD channel 0, 1 or 2 and then sets bit 0; the UHS-II fallback at 0xc65dc4 repeats it before rewriting the host power and clock words by read-modify-write, so a falling edge resets that SD host. 0xc65a04/0xc65e58 set and clear +0x14 bit 22 around the UHS-II attempt and 0xc621d0/0xc620b8 set and clear pad bits in +0x70 and +0x88; the section 6 USB start-up 0x15274f0 sets +0x100 bit 5, clears +0x118 bit 13 and +0x110 bit 2 and drives +0x10c bit 0 low and high again before it programs the DWC3; +0x08, +0x20 and +0x6c are read-modify-written by 0xc621a0, 0xc694fc, 0xcc0590 and 0xc65c7c. +0x08 holds the polarity of the sixteen external interrupt lines (0xc694d4 sets or clears bit n; set inverts line n), and line n is interrupt 151 + n (0xc5cfd4 maps interrupt rows 151..166 to lines 0..15): a line with a connected part drives its interrupt at the pin level, inverted by its polarity bit, and lines without one stay low. Words read back their last write; what the gate bits switch is not modeled.
